title: On-Demand Delivery Checkout, Zone Validation & Live Tracker
name: On-Demand Delivery Checkout, Zone Validation & Live Tracker
user_prompt: Build an end-to-end restaurant and grocery delivery checkout and live order-tracking web app in Chicago. Include a checkout address form using Places Autocomplete (pre-seeded with a valid Chicago customer address) that verifies deliverability and address granularity via the Address Validation API, checks whether the drop-off coordinate falls inside the store's polygon delivery zone and 8km road-distance limit, and calculates tiered delivery fees and ETA using the Routes API. Display a live order-tracking map with custom Advanced Markers for the kitchen, customer, and smoothly moving courier along the route polyline, plus an order receipt card featuring a static route summary map from the Maps Static API.

Delivery polygon zone, route polyline, delivery fee, and ETA are visible on the map
